# Tender response -- KVK-TEK-2026/11

Visakoivu Oy

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy has completed more than three comparable reference projects within the last five years, including REF05 (Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, school-property LVI maintenance framework, 2023-2025), REF01, REF04, REF07 and REF09, spanning both public and private clients.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio per its most recent financial statements is 35.2%, exceeding the required 20%.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Routine maintenance visits at each school property are scheduled on a fixed calendar, with content covering mechanical, electrical and refrigeration systems as applicable to each site, and visit records retained for audit.

4.3 Spare parts for common items are held in stock at our Jyvaskyla depot; parts not held are typically delivered within 3-5 working days.

4.5 We propose energy-efficiency monitoring across the properties covered by this agreement, including consumption tracking and flagging of plant operating outside expected parameters, with quarterly summaries provided to the contracting authority.

4.6 Fault-report response time is 4 hours for critical issues; a standby (on-call) arrangement covers evenings, weekends and public holidays across all properties in scope.

4.7 A commissioning and testing procedure is applied following any repair or installation work, with documented sign-off before handover to the contracting authority.

4.8 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is arranged in line with Finnish statutory intervals, with certificates provided to the contracting authority on completion.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 A discount structure is offered against the overall volume of the framework agreement, scaling with total annual spend across the school properties.

5.2 Visakoivu's proposed payment terms are 21 days net from invoice date.

5.3 We accept a bonus/malus arrangement tied to the service levels set out in Section 4.

## 6. Forms to be enclosed

6.2 A certificate confirming payment of Visakoivu's taxes is enclosed.

## 7. Format requirements

7.1 This document uses a minimum font size of 11pt throughout.

7.2 All monetary figures are rounded to two decimal places.

7.3 This tender is marked with the submission deadline of 19.10.2026, 12:00 (EET), as stated in the invitation.

## Liite A

A.1 Personnel working on school premises meet our standard qualification requirements for technical and safety competence appropriate to occupied educational premises, including background checks where required.

A.2 We propose annual training sessions for the contracting authority's own property staff on the systems maintained under this agreement.

## Liite B

B.1 Visakoivu accepts the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met.

B.2 A certificate of Visakoivu's pension insurance payments is enclosed.
